description: This file contains custom schema processing functions and a legacy schema class for DRF Spectacular integration, including modifications to request schemas and operation ID generation.

classes.name: LegacySchema
classes.description: A subclass of AutoSchema that customizes operation ID generation and path processing for legacy API support.

methods.name: custom_postprocessing_hook
methods.description: Modifies the schema components to make 'id' fields writable and not required in request schemas.

methods.name: path
methods.description: A cached property that cleans the URL path by removing prefix and path variables.

methods.name: get_operation_id
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID based on the view type and method.

methods.name: get_operation_id_base
methods.description: Determines the base name for operation IDs based on model, serializer, or view class.

methods.name: get_serializer
methods.description: Retrieves the serializer instance from the view, handling exceptions.
